briefdescription.para: Dispatches argv's own version, help, or manifest request.

detaileddescription.para: One argument that names an existing file goes to runDocument(). One argument that names no file goes to runDocumentNotFound(). More than one argument prints \<argument\>: unknown flag for the argument at postFlagArgIndex and returns EXIT_FAILURE. With no argument, the function prints the banner and the guide and returns EXIT_SUCCESS, the same as the help request.
